sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Peltophorum dasyrhachis is a 12–20 m tropical tree found in open forests and on slopes in southern China and tropical Asia.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The bipinnate leaves are about 15–35 cm long; the leaflets are 1.5–2 × 0.6–1 cm. Fragrant yellow flowers grow in terminal clusters. The flattened, winged pod is about 8–13 × 2.5–3 cm and usually contains three or four seeds.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use was found in the sources consulted.
